entities.name: nociceptive neurons of the dorsal root ganglia

relationships.subject: SCN9A
relationships.evidence_quote: This gene encodes the NaV1.7 voltage-gated sodium channel alpha subunit, predominantly expressed in nociceptive neurons localized on the dorsal root ganglia

relationships.subject: SCN9A
relationships.evidence_quote: Yang et al. made a significant breakthrough in 2004, identifying the gene responsible for PEM as SCN9A

relationships.subject: funapide
relationships.evidence_quote: two promising drugs, funapide (XEN402) and vixotrigine (BIIB074), both selective blockers of NaV1.7

relationships.subject: vixotrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: two promising drugs, funapide (XEN402) and vixotrigine (BIIB074), both selective blockers of NaV1.7

key_findings: Gain-of-function SCN9A (Nav1.7) mutations, with hyperpolarizing activation shift and slow deactivation, underlie primary erythromelalgia.
Selective Nav1.7 blockers funapide and vixotrigine show potential for managing PEM neuropathic pain.
